shape: 2-portal perimeter U-corridor (N + E gates around an impassable interior)
description: Two-portal stage where the walkable area is a thin perimeter corridor around an impassable interior. The path from spawn_north to spawn_east makes a П shape (back-of-house perimeter): north spawn (east column) → north entry hub → NW corner → SW-ish step on the west wall → east gate (south column). The hardest valley-B stage for the auto-solver (needs res 0.5 / clearance 0.9), which is why it's hand-authored as a strict 4-anchor backbone.

portals.north: spawn_north at (10.00, -22.94) — gate on the north (low-Z) side, east column
portals.east: spawn_east at (13.91, 15.52) — gate on the east (high-X) side, south column

NW corner pivot - bridge from north wall to west wall (matches e6ozoq)
west-side north end - bridge to east gate row (matches 8r1xfp)

traversalNotes: STRICT-BACKBONE perimeter: spawn_north → north_inner → nw_corner → west_n → spawn_east. 4 hops, single chain.
Interior of the room is NOT walkable (this is what defeated the auto-solver — it kept emitting straight-line shortcuts across the impassable middle).
Do not emit shortcuts. The U-shape is geometrically forced: north_inner is on the east column, west_n is on the west wall — the only connection is the NW corner.
